answer_1.quote: In this work, we formulate the task of visual TTS to generate audio with reverberation effects in target scenarios given a text and environmental image, introducing ViT-TTS to address the issues of data scarcity and room acoustic modeling.
answer_1.outputs: speech samples with accurate reverberation effects in target scenarios

answer_2.quote: The objective metrics we collected are designed to measure varied aspects of waveform quality between the ground-truth audio and the generated sample.

answer_4.quote: We use crowd-sourced human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk, where raters are asked to rate Mean Opinion Score(MOS) on a 1-5 Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: focus on examining the audio quality, naturalness and whether the audio matches with the given image.
